module: Flowgraph node "Rally Mode Recover In Place" (category repeat_p_duration, tags rally, recover, teleport). Recovers the vehicle in place, without pacenotes, route history or driveline: stores the current position and orientation, teleports with spawn.safeTeleport (with repair/reset if the recovery setting says so), restores the fuel via a snapshot (fuelUtils), then fires the hooks onVehicleTeleportedToLastRoad(vehId) and onRallyRouteRecoveryComplete({vehId, repairVehicle, inPlace = true}). Input: vehId (otherwise player vehicle 0), flow.
notes: The repair comes from gameplay_rallyLoop manager:getRecoveryRepairVehicle(), otherwise gameplay_rally.getRecoveryRepairVehicle(), otherwise the rallyRepairVehicleOnRecovery setting, otherwise true.

onNodeReset.desc: Clears the pending recovery and the fuel snapshot.

runRecovery.desc: Executes the pending recovery: teleports the vehicle, reapplies the fuel, emits the hooks.

startRecovery.desc: Prepares the recovery (current position/rotation, repair choice); first requests the fuel snapshot if repairing, then launches runRecovery.

work.desc: If flow is active, calls startRecovery.
